summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repo. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 + BEL format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. One docstring line was shortened to fit 88 characters, and Black was not run.
